summary: First testing pass on GoldCast Streaming MVP. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (health, M3U file create+dedupe, invalid/empty M3U, unreachable M3U URL, invalid scheme, unreachable Xtream, empty creds, device_id scoping + no password/_id leak, live-streams w/ playback_url, live-categories from group-title, delete cascade, delete 404, URL normalization no forced https). Frontend: Splash → Home auto-transition works, all Portuguese copy present, 5 bottom tabs render, Add List modal opens with 3 method segments, password field masked by default with visibility toggle, empty Xtream submit shows 'Preencha todos os campos.', URL M3U submission with iptv-org sample loaded a list and card appeared in 'Minhas listas' with real channel count (392) and Conectada status.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on Animated.View shine overlay. Cosmetic only.
Console warning: useNativeDriver not supported on web (falling back to JS). Not a bug, expected on web preview.

action_items: Optional: move pointerEvents="none" into the style prop of the shine Animated.View in app/index.tsx to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~570 lines and still readable, but if more features are added consider splitting into routers/services (lists, xtream, m3u).
sanitize_list is used on POST responses, but GET /lists and GET /lists/{id} rely on Mongo projection to strip password/_id — consistent, verified via tests.
Duplicate playback_url building for live/vod could be extracted to a helper.
Xtream password stored in plaintext in Mongo (required for API calls) — acceptable per requirement but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral lists under device_id 'test-device-agent' and clean up via fixture teardown (deletes all lists for that device_id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the public URL. Backend runs on :8001 internally. Cloudflare/ingress returns HTML 502 pages when backend takes >~30s (unreachable DNS); test helper _json_detail() handles this by only asserting Portuguese friendly message when the response is JSON. Reusable pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_goldcast_api.py.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Only a cosmetic React Native web deprecation warning about pointerEvents prop on Animated.View in the Splash screen.
